posts.text: Gulf Economies, Torn by War in Iran, Desperately Need a Return to Normal — States like Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates that have worked to rebalance from a dependence on energy have seen growth plunge in a year of strife.

Iran Says It Would Reopen Strait of Hormuz in 2 Days as Part of U.S. Deal — Iranian officials spoke of some progress in negotiating to reopen the strait even as they prepared for all-out war. A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Monday to meet with the foreign minister to continue talks.
Iran pushing accelerated plan for ceasefire talks with US — Tehran says plan has been condensed and can be implemented within two days as it continues talks with mediators.
China steps up Middle East diplomacy with Iran and Oman meetings — Beijing urges dialogue on US-Iran war, sends envoy to Gulf as Xi hosts first Omani head of state visit since 1978.
Iran's delegation has left negotiations in Qatar after a tense weekend. Here's where things stand — There are fears that Netanyahu could be pushing for new strikes in an effort to stay in power.

Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran — Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

Syria Weighs Joining Saudi Mutual Defense Pact as Yemen War Rages — A move to join Saudi Arabia’s agreement with Turkey and Pakistan could entangle more countries in the kingdom’s escalating conflict between the Iran-backed Houthis.

Iranian ‘ghost fleet’ filmed evading US blockade en route to China, UANI says — Smaller Iranian ghost fleet tankers are slipping past the U.S. naval blockade carrying sanctioned LPG fuel to China via a shadowy Malaysia anchorage.
